DEPARTMENT OF MICROBIOLOGY AND IMMUNOLOGY

INTERNATIONAL MEDIA & CITIES
INSTITUTE OF THE NATURE

The Council for Tobacco Research - U.S.A., Inc.
900 Third Avenue
New York, New York 10022

Attention: Donald M. Ford, Ph.D.
Associate Research Director

Re: Grant #1702

Dear Dr. Ford:

I would like to transfer $5,369.44 out of the Salaries and Fringe Benefits categories on the above grant. This money is to be placed into the Supplies ($4,369.44) and Miscellaneous ($1,000.00) categories.

I am requesting this transfer of funds because I am out of monies in both of those categories. The cost of supplies for molecular biology and tissue culture greatly exceed the $9,830.00 originally budgeted. The costs of maintaining the mouse breeding colony and the nude mice average nearly $200.00 per month. Only $922.50 was budgeted for this aspect of the work. I have five more months of payments for animal charges to cover before this funding period ends on June 30, 1986.

Thank you for your rapid approval of these transfers.

[SIGNATURE] Sincerely,
Monthly Bucklassen
